meta.description: What to expect at your first aikido training. Warm-up, breakfall practice, drilling techniques in pairs.

header.title: What to expect
header.subtitle: What awaits you at your first training

intro: If you are curious about what to expect at an aikido training session, we recommend visiting the following page and reading through everything carefully. Of course, nothing compares to personal experience.
sourceText: A detailed guide for beginners can be found at:
expectTitle: In general, expect the following at training
expectItems: Warm-up and stretching at the beginning
Breakfall practice (ukemi) – a fundamental skill in aikido
Demonstration of a technique by the instructor followed by paired practice
encouragement: Don't be afraid to come – everyone started as a complete beginner. The atmosphere at training is friendly and everyone is happy to help.
